answer.book: Clementis Timpler's Metaphysicae systema methodicum, libris quinque (Hanover, Petrus Antonius; title page 1616), a Latin metaphysics in five books with the Technologia, a treatise on liberal arts, added as its own work; it opens with a dedication to Count Arnold, a preface by Goclenius and the author's preface. The sheet covers the title pages, the front matter, the Technologia (its Caput I heading is missing), the index and table, and Metaphysicae liber I to liber III up to caput VII (liber II's heading and caput I are missing, duplicated scans are read once, the problemata are not listed as entries, and books IV and V are not on the sheet).
